title: Running and testing the mitmweb frontend
answers: How to run mitmweb frontend tests and linter?
How to start the mitmweb development server?
What Node version is required for mitmproxy web?
body:
Commands must be executed from the `web/` directory:
- Node.js >= 24 is required (`web/README.md`). Run `npm install` inside `web/`.
- Run full test suite (lint, typecheck, coverage): `npm test` which runs `eslint . && tsc --noEmit && jest --coverage` (`web/package.json`).
- Run a single test file: `npx jest src/js/__tests__/ducks/flows/indexSpec.tsx`.
- Development server: Run `uv run mitmweb` in the backend terminal, then run `npm start` (starts Vite dev server configured to proxy requests).
- Production build: `npm run ci-build-release` builds compiled assets into `mitmproxy/tools/web/static`.
